# pt-ai-plugins

The osinfra-io platform GitHub Copilot CLI plugin marketplace. It distributes on-demand skills, agents, and MCP integrations as versioned plugins (the `platform-grouping` plugin lives in `plugins/`; `techne-agents` is federated from `pt-techne-agents`). Plugins complement, and do not replace, the always-on instructions in `pt-ai-context`.
